title: CWP/19122/2025 of MS CREATIVE DESIGN GROUP Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS
text:
eae 147 IN THE PUNJAB AND HARYANA HIGH COURT AT CHANDIGARH Decided on:16.07.2025 M/s Creative Design Group .... Petitioner versus State of Haryana and others .... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. JUSTICE LISA GILL HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE MEENAKSHI I.MEHTA Present: Mr. H.S.Kasan, Advocate with Mr. Punit Verma, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Sukhdeep Parmar, Addl. AG, Haryana. sek Lisa Gill, J. (Oral)

1. Grievance raised by petitioner is that order dated 18.06.2025 (Annexure P-14) has been passed by respondent No.1 without issuance of any show cause notice.

2. Learned counsel for the State, on instructions from respondent No.5 stated to be present in Court, while conceding that show cause notice was indeed not issued submits that order dated 18.06.2025 (Annexure P-14) shall be withdrawn within next two days, however, liberty be afforded to respondents to pass fresh orders after issuance of show cause notice and after affording due and proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.

3. Keeping in view the specific statement made by learned counsel for the State on instructions from respondent No.5, no further orders are called as writ petition is rendered infructuous. Learned counsel for the petitioner is unable to deny the same. SONIA BURA &

4. Accordingly, writ petition is disposed of as infructuous. Liberty is afforded to respondents to pass fresh order in accordance with law after withdrawal of order dated 18.06.2025 in terms of the statement made before us by learned counsel for State. (LISA GILL) JUDGE 16.07.2025 (MEENAKSHI I. MEHTA) sonia JUDGE SONIA BURA
